verdict: Leads are coming in strong; the gap is in pipeline follow-through.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 165 leads at $12.96 per lead — well below the $19–45 range seen earlier this year, meaning your ad spend is working efficiently. Week over week, spend, leads, and cost per lead are all nearly flat, which signals a stable, healthy channel. The issue is downstream: 30 of those leads are not showing up in your pipeline, and no opportunities have been logged, pointing to a gap in how leads are being captured and followed up on once they arrive. We are moving immediately to close that intake gap so no paid lead goes unworked. By next week, retargeting automation is also going live, which will put previously unseen contacts back in front of your firm.
